title: Signs check and recital: At-Tariq and Al-Burooj 1 to 11: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: At-Tariq 9 to 17, Al-Burooj 1 to 11 and stopping signs
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 40 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Signs check and recital rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 40. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ (٩) فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ (١٠) وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ (١١) وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ (١٢) إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ (١٣) وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ (١٤) إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا (١٥) وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا (١٦) فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا (١٧)

keywords.def: a small mark above the line that tells us how to stop
the list the teacher uses to mark recitation

questions.q: Whole class recites Al-Burooj 1 to 11 together once.
Recital turns: today's group recites At-Tariq and Al-Burooj 1 to 11 and names two signs. Everyone else: rota revision and the log.
Extend: recite Al-Ghashiyah or Al-A'la from the rota.

questions.a: stop at one of the two
options: stop at one of the two

questions.q: Think again: Which is harder for you: remembering the words, or stopping in the right places? How will you practise it?
questions.a: Each pupil names one; we practise words with the 3-3-link and stops with the signs sheet.
